name: hn-datastar
description: The HN app on Datastar: the same routes, markup and data as the Solid apps, rendered on the server as plain HTML and navigated as a multi-page app. Comment collapse is a native <details>; CV=1 adds content-visibility, and TOGGLES=window keeps only the comments around the viewport, windowed on the server as you scroll. A hand-written port in Datastar's style, not one of Datastar's own demos.
